method.runtime: Four sequential disposable workers. Runtime network and host mounts disabled. Read-only root, non-root user, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, no pull, no logging and private 8 MiB scratch. Each probe was limited to 192 MiB, one CPU and 32 processes.
method.signatures: Run pdfsig -backend NSS -no-ocsp on the two-signature CMS fixture and use -backend GPG for both OpenPGP PDFs after importing the pinned public key into a private GNUPGHOME. The CMS follow-up supplied -nssdir sql:/scratch/nss after initializing the database through libnss3.
method.trustStore: Read Python ssl.create_default_context().cert_store_stats(). Select a public root certificate from the predecessor store and explicitly load the same certificate as cadata in both fresh contexts. Check its DER membership in get_ca_certs(binary_form=True).
